data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as an enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of one of your **SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD** units is picked for a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**.

**Target:** That **SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD**.

**Effect:** An enemy unit picked for a fall-back move while in Engagement Range of the unit has to fall back in **[desperate escape](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape-2)** mode. If it is **battle-shocked**, it gets -1 to its [hazard rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls) for that move.

effects.subject: each enemy unit engaged with the target that is selected to make a fall-back move
